name: Abjurers Strike
note: Weapon treats all targets as unarmoured and ignores magical DB bonuses; no vocabulary for suppressing parts of a target's defence.

name: Adapt Body
note: The half-damage-from-hazards clause would only become damage resistance if environmental damage is ever modelled.

name: Air Walk
mechanism: grant a movement mode or speed
note: Air-walking with a 45-degree cap and difficult-terrain ascent.

name: Alarm
note: Zone must watch for entry and oppose a Stealth check against the spell DC.

name: Align Weapon
note: trait effect grants the deity's aligned trait; authored on the weapon/projectiles rather than a creature.

name: Alluring Caress
note: Friendly/helpful attitude shift plus inability to act hostilely; ends if caster turns hostile.

name: Animal Growth
note: Carried equipment resizes and reverts when removed.

name: Animal Sense
note: Borrowed sense suppresses the caster's own; range/duration change for a companion or familiar.

name: Animal Spirit
note: Skill bonuses per mode are buildable; the cast-time pick is not, and modes also need swim/climb speeds, a granted Slam attack and a Natural DR bonus.

name: Animal Staff
note: Consumes the druidstaff and requires a statblock memorised via Study Target (Nature).

name: Animate Dead
note: Level-capped animated undead with the Minion trait, commanded on Sustain.

name: Animate Object
note: Duration field is empty and the object-level gp cost table is mangled into one run-on line.

name: Anticipate Attack
mechanism: scoped bonus or penalty to a stat, skill, save or combat field
note: bonus to the defence field; body says circumstance and the warp says status - pick one. Duration field is empty. Reaction trigger is printed casting text.

name: Anticipate Casting
note: Lowers the AP cost of the next spell by 1, then expires.

name: Anticipations
mechanism: scoped bonus or penalty to a stat, skill, save or combat field
note: +4 status bonus to the defence field with note scoping it to attacks by the target.

name: Antimagic Field
note: Suppresses the caster's own magic too; everything resumes intact at expiry.

name: Antipathy
note: Compulsion zone keyed to a caster-named creature kind or aligned trait; the -2 penalty on a successful save is a plain scoped penalty.

name: Augury
note: The secret DC 5 flat check could be rolled by the system even though the vision itself cannot.

name: Aura Of Vitality
mechanism: recurring effect at the start of each turn
note: heal exists, but not repeating it into an emanation each round, nor clearing persistent/bleed damage.

name: Avatar
note: Explicitly says the GM supplies the Avatar statistics.

name: Awaken Animal
note: No rule is given for how ability scores are 'amended accordingly' when the animal becomes a beast.

name: Banish Fatigue
mechanism: reduce or suppress a condition's value
note: condition applies values but does not subtract them; the +4 warp removes fatigue permanently, a different operation.

name: Banishment
note: On the target's critical success the caster becomes stunned 1 - the effect rebounds onto the caster.

name: Barkskin
note: Natural armour DR is not one of the bonus slots (attributes, skills, saves, attack, defence, initiative, spellcraft). Also gated on not wearing metal armour.

name: Beast Of Burden
note: Doubling is multiplicative and carrying capacity is not a bonus slot.

name: Bless Water
note: Output is a holy water item the player swaps in by hand; could optionally be automated as item creation.

name: Blink
mechanism: resistance or immunity to damage types
note: defence/resistance is qualitative, so 'resistance to all damage except force' is complete as written. The optional Sustain reposition is printed text.

name: Brawn
note: The +1 status bonus to Str, Con or Dex is a plain attribute bonus; only choosing which attribute at cast time is unexpressible.

name: Breeze
note: Only one Breeze may be active; recasting should dispel the previous casting, which is player bookkeeping.

name: Breeze Strike
note: Warp text reads 'increase the amount of penalty ignore by -1 (max -10)' - sign is confusing.

name: Bungle
note: Penalty attaches to one already-declared action, not to a slot. Ladder uses a 'Blunder' tier and omits 'Critical'.

name: Calm
note: Success tier (-1 status penalty to attack rolls) is buildable; the failure tier blocks hostile actions and suppresses other emotion effects.

name: Calm Animal
note: Same ladder as Calm, single-target.

name: Cancel Magic
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Advantage is not a bonus type; scoped to saves against one chosen tradition.

name: Channel The Aspect
note: The four modes are plain save/skill bonuses, but the mode is picked at cast and switchable for 1 AP; Limbs also grants quickened restricted to Move or Strike.

name: Charm Animal
note: Outcome ladder omits 'Critical'.

name: Charm Undead
note: Mindless undead get no save and are instead controlled outright with the minion trait.

name: Circle Of Warmth
note: Base duration is already Sustained (1 minute), so the +1 PP warp 'duration changes to 1 minute' changes nothing.

name: Clarity
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: One-shot: consumed by the next mental save, which then ends the spell.

name: Cloak Of Greying
note: Per-target sensory state, not a condition; Success tier is explicit GM discretion and the Fumble re-save at -20 is worth a human check.

name: Clone
note: Bespoke success ladder resolved 1d6+1 months later, with the casting check made at the end of the growth period rather than at casting.

name: Coercive Retribution
note: Resolves entirely as the command spell, which the spell effect kind covers. Trigger line reads 'Trigger: Requirement Your most recent action dealt damage' - malformed field.

name: Command
note: Dictates the first action of the target's next turn and blocks Delay and reactions until obeyed.

name: Command Swarm
note: Save field reads 'Will Negates' where every other spell uses a bare save name; also bypasses swarm mental immunity.

name: Conceal Thoughts
note: Two bonuses (+2 Deception vs Sense Motive, +4 on saves vs mind reading); the warp says 'increase the bonus' without saying which one.

name: Concealing Terrain
note: Requires significant plant life, which is a GM gate rather than a data condition.

name: Confident Veil
mechanism: reduce or suppress a condition's value
note: Lowers existing frightened by 1 and reduces incoming frightened; self-terminates with frightened +1 on a fumbled fear save.

name: Conjuration Shield
note: Zone must interrupt another caster's conjuration, force their Will save against this spell's DC and consume their PP on a failure.

name: Conjure Animal
note: Exact creature is GM-chosen; summon carries the Conjured trait and is commanded on Sustain.

name: Conjure Entity
note: Base cap is 9th level here versus level 1 for Conjure Animal/Elemental - check this is intended.

name: Conjure Eternal
note: Description has the CONJURE SPELLS sidebar pasted in twice.

name: Conjure Giant
note: Description repeats the effective-level paragraph twice.

name: Conjuring Control
note: Moves an existing summon's command link to a different caster.

name: Consecrate
note: Zone applies penalties to undead inside it and buffs attacks against them; body calls the secondary damage essence, the +4 warp calls it positive.

name: Contingency
mechanism: store a spell for later triggered release
note: Holds a second cast in reserve with a caster-named trigger; a new casting supersedes the old.

name: Continual Light
note: Duration is already 'unlimited' yet a +1 PP warp makes it permanent.

name: Control Water
note: Raising/lowering water is terrain; the Slowed 1 on water-trait creatures is a plain condition. Duration field is empty.

name: Counter Perform
note: Bonus size is derived by comparing the Perform check to the Bonus check table against the incoming Save DC.

name: Courage
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Advantage on saves against Fear-trait effects.

name: Create Undead
note: No effect kind creates or transforms a creature; the minion/command rules and the PP-vs-gp cost table are also authoring-only text flattened into one unreadable line.

name: Cutting Words
mechanism: scoped bonus or penalty to a slot
note: Each degree is a negative circumstance bonus on slot attack (and the relevant skill), scoped by note to the triggering action.

name: Dancing Lights
note: Illumination is a graded scale in this game but is not a bonus slot or a defence field; sustaining to move the spheres is otherwise fine.

name: Dareveil
note: '+1 to any effects with the fear trait' presumably means saves against fear

name: Darkness
note: Also a text bug: the body's stray 'PP +4' line contradicts the listed +2 PP warp.

name: Darkvision
note: kind:trait grants Darkvision; both warps are range/duration changes the warp system already handles.

name: Dead Tongue
note: the +1 PP 'won't attack you' warp is an NPC-behaviour clause the GM adjudicates

name: Death Knell
mechanism: effect scaled by the target's level
note: Dying+1 is a plain condition, but the caster's healing is formula-scaled off the TARGET's level (@casterLevel is the only level token) and the failure tier kills outright. Text bug: 'you 1 HP for every level' is missing its verb.

name: Death Ward
note: The +4 status bonus to saves (note 'vs essence and death') and the qualitative essence resistance are both buildable today; only 'ignores the Doomed condition' has no expression. Target line is buried in the description instead of the target field.

name: Deathless
note: Needs to intercept the death threshold when HP exceeds Death State while still allowing death from criticals, death effects and soul drain.

name: Deathwatch
note: 'and if the value of any injured and bleed conditions' should read 'the value'

name: Decursive Veil
mechanism: immunity scoped to a spell category and PP threshold
note: defence/immunity takes named damage types, not 'insight spells of PP 2 or lower', and the +1 warp raises that threshold. Concealment and the frightened/sickened reduction are close to condition authoring.

name: Defer Fatality
note: Suspended animation on a death trigger, ending only when healed. Duration lives in the description rather than the duration field, and both warps cost +1 PP for very different durations.

name: Deflect Flame
mechanism: resistance or immunity by damage type
note: Resistance here is qualitative, so the absent magnitude is not a gap: defence/resistance values ['fire'], with the +4 warp switching the duration to 1 minute.

name: Deflections
mechanism: scoped bonus or penalty to a slot
note: -4 circumstance on slot attack against the triggering attack; the +2 warp just deepens the value and the other warps re-scope which attack type triggers it.

name: Deific Enhancement
mechanism: scoped bonus or penalty to a slot
note: slot accepts any attribute, so this is one bonus entry per ability (or a cast-time pick); derived rolls follow from the attribute itself. Warps adjust value and duration.

name: Deific Knowing
note: Advantage is a roll state, not a typed bonus; the warp ladder widens which checks it applies to but never changes that.

name: Delay Pain
note: Needs to ignore up to N points of dazed/weakened/injured without clearing them, then convert the ignored total into fatigue when the duration ends.

name: Delayed Respite
mechanism: delayed application of an attack's effects
note: Damage and criticals are rolled now but held for a round and applied in full when the duration expires.

name: Desecrate
note: Bonuses, penalties and 1d4 secondary essence damage must attach to an area that keeps applying to whoever is inside it. Text bug: says it 'blesses' the area, wording copy-pasted from Consecrate.

name: Detect Life
note: A tertiary sense that substitutes Power Manipulation for Perception checks; trait grants cannot redirect which skill a sense rolls.

name: Detect Scrying
note: the opposing caster's Will save is rolled off-screen by the GM

name: Detect Signature
note: the Trace Signature warp's escalating tracking DC is a GM-run skill check

name: Detect Undead
note: Same tertiary-sense substitution as Detect Life.

name: Devastating Might
note: DR is a numeric reduction and the warps strip resistance from others; defence/resistance only grants qualitative resistance, it cannot subtract it. Emanation is centred on the caster and hits the caster too.

name: Dimension Door
mechanism: movement handled by moving the token
note: the +2 PP warp adds an hour-long temporary immunity that would need tracking

name: Dimension Shift
mechanism: movement handled by moving the token

name: Dimensional Lock
note: The area must stand for a day making counteract checks against teleportation, planar travel, extradimensional items and summoning that cross it.

name: Disappearance
note: needs an undetected condition that covers all senses, not just sight

name: Discern Lies
note: 'disbelieve illusions' must exist as a bonus scope

name: Disgrace
mechanism: forcing a save on another creature's action
note: The -2 status penalty to Deception/Diplomacy/Intimidate/Performance is buildable as four bonus entries; the gap is other creatures rolling Will when they try to cooperate, plus auto-failing any magical Charisma bolstering. Last sentence is truncated ('they hesitate and refuse,').

name: Disjunction
note: Counteract against an item, inert for a week on success, destroyed on a critical. Text bug: 'this spell has effect on an artifact' almost certainly should read 'has no effect'.

name: Disorient
note: The Success tier (-1 circumstance) is a plain bonus entry; the Failure and Fumble tiers impose disadvantage, which has no representation.

name: Displacement
note: Incoming attacks made at disadvantage, and it then expires per attacker once that attacker lands a critical, which needs per-attacker tracking.

name: Disrupting Weapon
mechanism: damage rider on a weapon's attacks
note: kind:damage applies to a creature; nothing attaches recurring secondary damage to a weapon item's own attacks. Warps add weapons and raise the die count.

name: Dissipate Into Mist
note: Insubstantial, untargetable and unable to act until end of turn, then reforms within 15 feet; it also suppresses and reinstates the caster's own auras.

name: Divine Grace
mechanism: one-shot bonus consumed by the next matching roll
note: Otherwise a plain +3 status bonus across the Charisma skills; the missing part is that it is spent by the first qualifying check, with warps only extending the window.

name: Divine Might
note: Setting Base Attack Bonus equal to caster level is an assignment, not a bonus. The +1 status to Str and Con and the physical-resistance warp are both buildable; the size-increase warp is not.

name: Divine Vision
note: duration field is empty though the text refers to 'the Duration'; 'You all into a deep trance' should read 'fall'

name: Divinity Purge
note: Counteracts all charm and compulsion effects, auto-succeeding when caster and target share a deity, and forgives conduct violations committed while charmed.

name: Doubt
note: Also needs a fresh secret save each time the spell is sustained, with the result hidden from the target.

name: Draining Burst
note: 'Soul Drain' must exist as a damage type; area is an emanation but the range field is empty

name: Drop Dead
mechanism: effect ends on a triggering action
note: The invisibility itself is a plain condition; what is missing is termination when the target takes a hostile action (which the +4 warp removes), plus the illusory corpse and its disbelief check.

name: Earth Bind
note: Failure and Fumble tiers block Fly/levitate for a set time, and every tier includes forced downward movement (a safe fall of up to 120 feet).

name: Earth Glide
note: Grants a burrow speed of 5 feet (warp raises it to 20); speed and movement types are not bonus slots.

name: Earth Prison
note: Slowed 1 on Success is buildable; Failure buries the target 100 feet down in suspended animation, and Fumble adds a -5 circumstance penalty to attempts to locate them.

name: Echolocation
note: kind:trait granting blindsight 40 feet for the parsed 1-hour duration.

name: Effortless Armour
mechanism: bonus to a statistic outside the slot list
note: Neither Speed nor armour check penalty is a bonus slot (slots cover attributes, skills, saves, attack, defence, initiative, spellcraft). Description also ends mid-sentence with a comma.

name: Eldritch Shield
note: Scope must narrow the DB bonus to spell attacks only.

name: Eldritch Weapon
note: The base conjured weapon maps onto kind:attack (force damage, normal proficiency); the +2/+3 warps infusing a potency I-IV rune have no expression.

name: Element Ward
mechanism: resistance or immunity by damage type
note: defence/resistance with the chosen type, scoped by note to the triggering effect's initial damage; the +8 warp swaps field to immunity.

name: Elemental Fury
mechanism: triggers off your next spell cast
note: Damage equals 1 HP per PP of the NEXT spell cast, inherits its damage type, and pools with that spell's damage before resistances and weaknesses are applied.

name: Elemental Speech
note: 'Intelligence score of -2 or greater' reads like a modifier, not a score.

name: Elude Time
note: Stasis with the caster choosing the expiry point at cast time and total invulnerability until then.

name: Embrace Destiny
mechanism: replace a roll with a recorded result
note: Rolls and stores a d20 to substitute for a later attack, save or skill check, with a one-instance-at-a-time restriction.

name: Enchanting Utterance
note: Failure and Fumble forbid hostile actions against the caster. The Success tier's -1 circumstance to attack is buildable, but its -1 damage-roll penalty has no slot and no bonus type given.

name: Endure Elements
note: Explicitly grants no fire or cold damage protection, so nothing numeric is owed.

name: Enervation
note: Persistent essence damage across three tiers, plus 'soul drain' which appears to be a separate damage track. Doomed 1 on a Fumble is buildable. No range is given for the 30-foot line.

name: Entangle
note: Difficult terrain plus a per-round Escape check at the spell DC for creatures starting their turn inside, with speed penalty and immobilisation on failure.

name: Entropic Shield
note: Written as a penalty to incoming ranged attacks rather than a bonus to DB.

name: Eternal Aspect
mechanism: grants an extra or modified action
note: The acrobatics mode is a plain circumstance bonus, but one mode grants a non-provoking move action, and 'luck' is not one of the engine's bonus types (status/circumstance/item).

name: Ethereal Jaunt
note: Plane shift plus invisibility, object phasing, halved speeds, limited cross-plane perception, and 1 damage per foot displaced if it ends inside an object.

name: Fairy Fire
note: Blocks concealment on visible creatures and downgrades invisible ones from undetected to concealed; both are detection-state overrides rather than condition grants.

name: False Arrogance
mechanism: penalty triggered by the target's own failed rolls
note: A self-escalating -1 then -2 status penalty that arms on each failed attack or check. Uses a 'Partial' degree of success that the other save spells in this batch do not have.

name: False Health
note: Formula is spellcasting ability score x2, scaled by the warp.

name: False Mire
note: Difficult terrain plus a save on entry and a repeatable Will save or Escape each turn. No critical-success entry is listed, only Success/Failure/Fumble.

name: False Vision
note: Unsure: the PP comparison and disbelief check are mechanical, but what a scryer perceives is not.

name: Fateful Temptation
mechanism: shift a roll's degree of success
note: The +2 status bonus to the triggering save is buildable; promoting a success to a critical and a failure to an unmitigatable fumble is not.

name: Feather Fall
note: No falling model exists to hook; nothing to compute beyond not applying fall damage.

name: Flame Blade
note: kind:attack granting a scimitar-like attack that rolls Spellcraft at -2 and deals fire damage with fire criticals.

name: Flaming Weapon
mechanism: damage rider on a weapon's attacks
note: 1d6 secondary fire damage attached to a weapon item's attacks (warp to 3d6); same gap as Disrupting Weapon.

name: Flawless Lies
note: Advantage on all Deception checks for 10 minutes. The skill is written as 'Bluff (Deception)' - confirm which name the config skill list uses.

name: Floating Disk
note: Carrying capacity and the end conditions are tracked at the table.

name: Fluidity
mechanism: grants an extra or modified action
note: A Stride or Step folded into the cast; also ignores difficult terrain, and the +5-foot status bonus is to Speed, which is not a bonus slot.

name: Fly
mechanism: grant a Speed for a movement type
note: No effect kind sets a fly Speed derived from land Speed; the Feather Fall landing is narrative.

name: Foe To Friend
note: The -5 circumstance penalty on Success is a plain attack-slot bonus; retargeting the attack is not expressible.

name: Fools Riches
note: Who is 'susceptible to the allure of material riches' is a GM call; area is a 5-foot burst but affects creatures within 20 feet, and no fumble entry is given.

name: Forbiddance
note: Needs an area that auto-counters conjuration/teleport casts made inside it.

name: Force Prison
mechanism: confine a creature with escape saves
note: Damage per degree maps to damage effects; the cage that blocks movement and repeated escape attempts does not.

name: Force Punch
mechanism: secondary damage rider on weapon attacks
note: 1d6 force added to every unarmed attack for the duration; damage effects are auto-hit, not riders.

name: Forget
note: Only the Will save is mechanical; the suppressed memories are pure narration.

name: Freedom
note: The counter of speed-impairing magic maps to defence/immunity values; only the auto-succeeded Escape is missing.

name: Freezing Touch
mechanism: apply an entry from the critical tables
note: Minor Cold Critical on a failed Will save; warp raises severity one step.

name: Freezing Weapon
mechanism: secondary damage rider on weapon attacks
note: 1d6 cold on all attacks with the touched weapon, scaling to 3d6 by warp.

name: Gaseous Form
note: Resistance and immunities are buildable defence effects, but the loss of armour bonuses, the action lockout and the fly Speed are not.

name: Gate
note: Portal placement and travel are table-side; requires a plane stored via Study Target.

name: Geas
note: Whether the target is complying is a judgement call; target level is capped by the spell's PP cost.

name: Ghostly Lanterns
note: 1d6 sustained figures that move with the caster; also steps illumination.

name: Ghostly Weapon
note: Assumes a trait effect can be applied to an item rather than a creature; if not, this needs an item-targeting mechanism.

name: Glimpse
note: The Search check is an ordinary skill check the player already makes.

name: Globe Of Cancellation
note: Auto-counters every spell crossing the sphere using Spellcraft, nullifying only the intersecting portion.

name: Glyph Of Protection
mechanism: store a spell to trigger later
note: Stores a lower-PP hostile spell, inherits its traits, and needs trap Perception/Thievery DCs plus a concurrency cap.

name: Goodberry
note: The +2 circumstance Medicine bonus is buildable; the 5 berries with a shared 8-point/24-hour cure cap are not.

name: Grace
mechanism: take an action as part of casting
note: Free move on cast, plus movement that does not provoke reactions until end of turn.

name: Grant Spell
mechanism: limited daily uses on a granted spell
note: kind:spell already grants a spell to a target; the 1/day innate use limit and cast-time choice of any available PP 2 spell are not expressible.

name: Gravity Weapon
note: 'Base damage die gains a +2 bonus' is ambiguous — added to the result, or a die-size step?

name: Gustborn Movement
mechanism: grant a Speed for a movement type
note: Fly Speed equal to land Speed; safe descent on expiry is narrative.

name: Harrow
note: Save DC is a fixed Very Easy (-5) step rather than spell DC; needs a per-spell DC-step field.

name: Haze Of Dreams
note: Fumble's slowed 1 is a buildable condition; halving Speed to the next 5-foot increment on Failure is not.

name: Healer’s Grace
mechanism: modify the PP or warping of other spells
note: Treats every Healing-trait spell cast as warped 2 PP higher for free.

name: Heightened Awareness
mechanism: dismiss the spell for a triggered bonus
note: Both skill bonuses are buildable bonus effects; only the dismiss-for-+20-initiative clause is missing.

name: Hide From Animals
note: Overrides blindsense/scent/tremorsense for one creature type and ends on a hostile action.

name: Hide From Undead
note: Auto-applies to mindless undead, Will save for intelligent ones; ends on attack or positive energy.

name: Hindsight
note: Only numeric clause is the -5 circumstance penalty when skimming.

name: Hunters Spirit
note: The no-half-speed-while-tracking clause is overland travel narration.

name: Hypercognition
mechanism: grant an extra action once per round
note: The +5 status bonus on the four named checks is buildable; the once-per-round free action and the dismiss-for-advantage clause are not.

name: Ice Slick
note: Makes a 10-foot radius difficult terrain; no duration is printed.

name: Identify
mechanism: spell that resolves as another action
note: Resolves as an Identify Power check at -5 and tracks a +2 on later attempts against the same object.

name: Indomitable
note: Reduces dazed or weakened by 2 the first time it is applied, then ends. Printed text is missing a word ("the first time you them").

name: Inner Focus
note: Suppresses the focus-component requirement and the no-Spell-Focus penalty.

name: Inner Sanctum
note: The +2 status bonus to saves vs possession/fear/translocation is a buildable bonus with a scope note; the counteract against translocation cast inside and the light step are not.

name: Insanity
mechanism: roll on a random effect table each round
note: D10 table at the start of each turn; duration keyed to margin of failure.

name: Inspiration
mechanism: reaction that modifies a triggering roll
note: Adds 1d6 to the triggering check and cannot avert an open-ended result.

name: Inspire Competence
mechanism: spell that resolves as another action
note: Resolves as an Aid action using the spell's own check result, minimum +1.

name: Inspire Heroics
note: Advantage is not a bonus value; one check per creature per round also needs per-round tracking.

name: Invisibility Purge
mechanism: persistent aura affecting creatures in the area
note: Suppresses invisibility on anything inside the emanation while it remains there.

name: Invisibility Sphere
mechanism: invisibility that ends on a hostile action
note: Also ends per-creature on leaving the area, permanently for that creature.

name: Invisible Item
mechanism: invisibility that ends on a hostile action
note: Applies to an object; ends when the object is used in a hostile action.

name: Invulnerability
mechanism: blanket immunity to all effects and damage
note: defence/immunity takes named values, so immunity to any effect is not expressible; the artifact and deific exceptions are a GM call.

name: Iron Body
note: Str/Dex bonuses, Adamantine resistance and the Slam attack are buildable; the construct type, Base DR override, halved Speed and -8 ACP are not.

name: Iron Wood
mechanism: change an item's material or properties
note: Requires Densewood to exist as a material and a spell effect that can swap an item's material.

name: Jump
note: Base bonus is +4 but the warp raises it in +5 steps to a max of +50 — looks inconsistent.

name: Keen Edge
note: Granting the Keen quality maps to a trait grant; the per-projectile burn across 50 projectiles does not.

name: Knock
note: The +4 status bonus to Athletics/Thievery is a buildable skill-slot bonus; counteracting Lock and the Pick Lock on cast are not.

name: Levitate
mechanism: grant a Speed for a movement type
note: The -2 circumstance attack penalty is buildable; the vertical lift, 1 AP raise and stabilize action are not.

name: Life Siphon
mechanism: reaction keyed to another spell you cast
note: Healing scales from the triggering spell's PP, not caster level.

name: Lifekeeping
note: Conditions can be applied or removed, but not frozen at their current value. Text says Dying while the target line says Death's Door.

name: Light
note: Two illumination steps on an object, capped at 8, and recasting must end the prior instance.

name: Lighten Object
mechanism: change an item's material or properties
note: Halves item weight and reduces armour ACP without changing its category.

name: Lock
note: DC is spell DC +5; no object-DC model exists for the engine to write to.

name: Long Arm
note: Reach is not among the bonus slots.

name: Loremasters Edge
note: Reaction granting advantage on the triggering Recall Knowledge check.

name: Lucky Break
note: Rerolls the failed save and sets a 10-minute per-target immunity timer.

name: Luminance
mechanism: persistent aura affecting creatures in the area
note: Heals or damages by creature type at the start of each turn, escalating to 5d8 when sustained; also a light step.

name: Magic Jar
note: Soul transfer, gem receptacle, repeated possession attempts and death handling are all outside the vocabulary.

name: Magic Jaws
mechanism: item bonus to attack or defence
note: Potency rune on an unarmed attack authors as an item bonus to the attack slot, with warps stepping the value and duration.

name: Magic Stone
note: The +1 item bonus and disruptive trait are buildable; the pebbles crumbling after one use are not.

name: Magic Vestment
mechanism: item bonus to attack or defence
note: Potency I armour or shield rune authors as an item bonus to the defence slot; the warp steps it to III.

name: Magic Volley
mechanism: change an item's material or properties
note: Overrides the ammunition's damage type at cast time and adds the matching elemental trait.

name: Magic Weapon
mechanism: item bonus to attack or defence
note: Potency I weapon rune authors as an item bonus to the attack slot; the warp steps it to IV.

name: Mana Drain
mechanism: draw on another creature's PP pool
note: Spending a target's PP, plus repeated saves to break the link and a range that changes once linked.

name: Map Of The Root-knit
note: Five persistent linked points with a once-per-round activation by caster or allies; no effect kind places or links terrain markers.

name: Mark Of Faith
mechanism: bonus or penalty to a slot
note: bonus slot attack, +1 circumstance, note 'vs the marked target'; condition-free penalty as bonus slot fortitude/reflex/will value -1, note 'vs the caster's spells'. Warps scale value and target count. The caster-only illumination step is printed text.

name: Masterwork Item
note: Temporarily raises an item's quality tier to expert/master/legendary; no effect kind writes to an item's fields.

name: Maze
mechanism: banish a creature from the field
note: Removes the target from play for a save-scaled duration; the hunter creature and the caster's Stunned 2 on its defeat ride on the same missing mechanic.

name: Meld Into Stone
note: Expulsion inflicts a GM-chosen Serious Critical.

name: Memory Lapse
note: Whether a social-check retry is allowed is explicitly a GM call.

name: Metabolism
note: Regeneration 5 for the duration. The bleed reduction and the step-down of dazed/injured/weakened are also condition-value edits rather than condition applications.

name: Metal To Wood
note: Converts metal gear to wood with -2 attack/damage, armour DR -2 and HP halved; no effect kind writes to an item's fields.

name: Mind Blank
note: The +4 status bonus to mental saves is plain data (bonus, slot will/fortitude/reflex, note 'vs mental effects'). Only the counteract of insight spells at PP+4 is missing.

name: Mind Cleanse
note: Also needs removal of already-applied mental effects and ability penalties, not just application of new ones.

name: Mind Reading
note: Every save outcome delivers information only; the 1-hour per-caster immunity is hand-tracked.

name: Mind’s Double
note: Duplicate perceptible to one target only, with a disbelief ladder by degree of success.

name: Mirage Entity
mechanism: summoned entity with its own stat block
note: Illusory creature acting on its own AP, using the caster's Spellcraft as attack and DB, dealing 1d4+5 mental damage, with disbelief refunding half.

name: Mirror Image
note: d100 thresholds 26/34/51 that step as duplicates pop, and only attack-trait effects consume an image.

name: Misdirection
note: Only bites when something is reading auras, which is itself unautomated.

name: Mislead
note: Invisibility is a plain condition; the commandable duplicate and the Deception-vs-Perception attribution are the missing clauses.

name: Missile Storm
note: The damage kind's count distributes missiles, but here count is 2d6+6 plus 1d6 per size category above Medium, so it cannot be a static number.

name: Misty Step
note: Teleport is just the player moving the token 30 feet.

name: Moment Of Fortune
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Advantage on one saving throw, consumed on use; also one live casting at a time.

name: Moment Of Renewal
note: 'As if 24 hours of rest' is not a heal formula, and it clears every effect that would lapse in a day; plus a 1-day per-target immunity.

name: Natural Animosity
note: DC 8 flat check at the start of each turn producing swarm criticals, plus a DC 5 spell-failure check on verdant casts. The Speed penalty also has no matching bonus slot.

name: Nature’s Bounty
note: The 3d10+12 heal is plain; the missing part is a conjured fruit any creature can eat as a 1 AP action, decaying after 1 minute.

name: Nexus Of Elemental Energy
mechanism: persistent zone affecting creatures within it
note: Per-turn save with element-dependent save type and damage type, plus an amp to elemental spells cast into the zone (+1 die, -2 to saves).

name: Nondetection
note: Standing ward that counteracts divinations aimed at the target.

name: Object Prowess
mechanism: one-shot bonus consumed by the next roll
note: The standing +2 status bonus to Create checks is plain data (bonus, slot crafting skill). Only the dismiss-for-double-bonus clause is missing.

name: Obscuring Mist
mechanism: persistent zone affecting creatures within it
note: Concealment applied both ways across the cloud boundary to creatures who enter later, and an optional 10 ft per round drift.

name: Orb Of The Void
mechanism: persistent zone affecting creatures within it
note: Caster-moved sphere that applies Soul Drain 2d8 on entry or on ending a turn inside, with undead exempt.

name: Pariah
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Disadvantage on Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidate and Perform is the missing clause; the initial-attitude shift is GM-side.

name: Pass Without Trace
mechanism: raise a DC others roll against
note: Buffs the DC of other creatures' tracking checks, taking the higher of +4 or the caster's spell DC; the bonus slot list has no such field.

name: Phantasmal Revenge
note: The GM decides who the killer was and where; once known, the payload is just a `spell` effect casting phantasmal killer.

name: Phantom
mechanism: summoned entity with its own stat block
note: Phantasmal enemy mirroring the target's own capabilities, with a disbelief save only once the target has reason to doubt.

name: Phantom Steed
mechanism: summoned entity with its own stat block
note: Real stat block (DB 15, DR 4, 10 HP, auto-fails saves); warps change Speed and movement types.

name: Physical Boost
mechanism: one-shot bonus consumed by the next roll
note: The +1 status bonus maps to bonus entries on strength, dexterity and constitution with a self-expiring duration; only the consume-on-first-check clause is missing.

name: Physical Surge
note: Also a +2 status bonus to Athletics; the free 0 AP Stride/Leap/Climb/Swim is player-executed.

name: Planar Ally
note: Payment, bargaining and the assigned task are entirely GM territory.

name: Planar Contact
mechanism: condition value scaled by the margin of failure
note: Fatigue equal to the amount the Will save is failed by; the five answers are GM-supplied text.

name: Planar Enquiry
note: What the called eternal learns is GM-decided; the Gather Information check is rolled by hand.

name: Polymorph Other
note: Sickened 1 on a success is plain; failure and fumble swap the target's form, and failure allows a repeat Will save for spending all actions.

name: Possession
mechanism: take control of another creature's turns
note: Also per-turn re-saves, the caster's body falling unconscious, and a Fort save with paralysis if the host dies.

name: Power Crystal
note: Crystal holds PP spendable by whoever holds it and dissolves when drained or at 24 hours.

name: Precious Metals
note: Retypes an item's material for 1 minute, with damage dealt according to the new material.

name: Prescience
mechanism: one-shot bonus consumed by the next roll
note: Dismissed as a free action for a +2 circumstance bonus to the next roll, or to DB against one incoming attack; must be spent before the dice are rolled.

name: Project Image
note: Non-radius spells may originate from the image, and the spell ends if the image is hit or fails a save.

name: Protection
mechanism: bonus or penalty to a slot
note: bonus, slot defence and each save, +2 status, note 'vs creatures and effects of the chosen aligned trait'; a second pair at +4 with note 'vs control effects and attacks by summoned creatures of that trait'. The opposing-trait tagging is spell metadata.

name: Protection From Arrows
mechanism: effect that discharges after a number of uses
note: Resistance to missile attacks is fine as a qualitative defence value; the missing clause is the discharge after 10 attacks.

name: Protective Circle
note: The +2/+4 status bonuses to DB and saves for the caster and allies in the radius are plain bonus data; the missing clause is the Will-save gate stopping summoned creatures of the chosen trait from entering, with the first success locked in.

name: Protector’s Sphere
mechanism: resistance or immunity to a damage type
note: defence, field resistance, values physical, for the caster and allies in the 15-foot radius; warps add adamantine and then all damage. Resistance here is qualitative, so no magnitude is owed. Base text reads 'Physical Resistance (adamantine)' while the +6 warp adds adamantine, so the base line likely means physical except adamantine.

name: Prying Eye
mechanism: summoned entity with its own stat block
note: Flying eye moved by the caster's actions, destroyed by any damage; also vision transfer that blinds the caster while in use.

name: Punishing Winds
mechanism: persistent zone affecting creatures within it
note: Forced 40-foot descent then 20 feet per turn airborne, terrain modification, fall damage on impact, and an Athletics/Acrobatics check to cross the cylinder wall.

name: Qualm
note: Negative-value bonus effect scoped to all actions, varying by degree of success.

name: Quick Time
note: Duration header says sustained (1 minute) but the text grants the bonus "for 1 round" — contradiction.

name: Radiant Aegis
mechanism: bonus or penalty to a slot
note: bonus, slot defence, +1 status, for allies in the emanation, note 'vs attacks by creatures of an opposing aura type'; warps scale radius and value. The aura-type comparison lives in the note as scope text.

name: Rage
mechanism: apply an effect when the spell ends
note: The +1 to strength and constitution and +1 to mental saves are plain bonus data; the missing clauses are fatigued 10 for 1 hour on expiry and the bans on defensive and concentrate actions.

name: Rainbow Cloak
note: A melee hit on the target forces the attacker to save or be blinded/stunned, with per-attacker immunity until end of their turn; the dazzle aura on adjacent creatures rides on the same trigger.

name: Rapid Repair
note: Fast healing 1 on a construct, non-stacking, warping up to 5.

name: Reaper’s Resonance
mechanism: value derived from the triggering effect
note: Heal is the triggering creature's level plus 5, doubled if it was undead; formulas only reach @casterLevel. The warp also converts HP healed into bleed reduction.

name: Reincarnated Embrace
mechanism: GM-adjudicated resurrection in a new body
note: Text never says who chooses the new race; also wipes 24 hours of memory and all PP until next preparation.

name: Reincarnation
mechanism: GM-adjudicated resurrection in a new body
note: Refers to 'if the check succeeds' but names no check.

name: Repulsion
note: Save-scaled difficult terrain, an outright block on approach, and prone, locked in per creature for the duration. The outcome list prints Failure twice; the second is presumably Fumble.

name: Resilient Fortitude
mechanism: value derived from the triggering effect
note: Resistance is qualitative so no magnitude is owed, but the resisted type is read from the triggering attack and applies only to it.

name: Resilient Sphere
mechanism: summoned entity with its own stat block
note: Sphere with DB 10, Hardness 10 and 40 HP that blocks passage; the save degree changes its HP or collapses it.

name: Resist Energy
mechanism: resistance or immunity to a damage type
note: defence, field resistance, values the chosen energy type. Resistance is qualitative in this system, so the absent magnitude is not a gap. Warps add targets and a second energy type.

name: Resistance
mechanism: flat bonus to a saving throw
note: 'Resistance' is not one of the engine's bonus types (circumstance/status/item/class/untyped).

name: Resonance Manipulation
mechanism: bonus or penalty to a slot
note: The fumble result is bonus entries on intelligence, wisdom and charisma at -2 status for 1 minute. The sound alteration itself is printed text. Header save field is empty though the text calls for a Will save.

name: Restoration
note: Applying a condition is expressible; decrementing one already on the target is not. Soul drain is a separate resource, and the once-per-day-per-creature limit is a table call.

name: Restore Senses
note: Removing the blinded/deafened conditions would be a condition effect, but the spell only does so if the counteract succeeds.

name: Resurrection
mechanism: restore a dead creature to life
note: Setting HP/PP/pools to fixed values and decrementing the Death State resource have no effect kind. The injured 2 for 1 week is a plain condition effect.

name: Revealing Glance
note: Secret GM check per illusion, re-run whenever a new illusion enters an area that moves with the caster.

name: Revelation Divine
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: The bonus effect carries flat values only; advantage is not a numeric bonus.

name: Reverse Gravity
note: Needs a standing volume that inverts falling for anything inside it, plus falling damage on impact.

name: Ride The Lightning
note: The +10 warp adds 8d12 electricity with a basic Reflex save, which is a buildable damage effect.

name: Rope Trick
note: A menu of commands chosen at cast and again on each Sustain. Bind is a granted attack whose hit applies a Speed penalty that ends on Escape.

name: Rune Of Warding
note: +1 status bonus to defence and to fortitude/reflex/will on the creatures designated at cast time, 8-hour duration, warped to 24 hours. Author the designated creatures as the targets; the radius gate is left to the table.

name: Sacrificing Shield
note: Reduces incoming damage on one creature and moves it onto the caster, bypassing the caster's own resistances, weaknesses and immunities.

name: Sanctuary
note: The opponent saves when it tries to attack, once per opponent per turn, with degrees that eat the action. Spell ends on a hostile action by the protected creature.

name: Scrying
note: Save degrees set a 1-day or 1-week immunity per target, and the degree shifts one worse if the target was stored with Study Target. The sensor itself is printed text.

name: See Invisible
note: Grant the sense as a trait effect for 10 minutes; the +2 warp to 8 hours and the +4 warp removing concealment are warp mods on the same trait.

name: Seer’s Vision
mechanism: stored roll result replacing a later roll
note: Roll and record a d20 now, spend it in place of a later save or skill check. Recasting cancels the stored result.

name: Self Mirage
note: The clause ignoring disguise circumstance penalties stays a manual GM call.

name: Shadow Walk
note: Triggers a Resonance Event on a Spellcraft roll of 13 - confirm whether the core resonance system already covers that.

name: Shadow Weapon
note: Grant a melee attack (player picks the weapon) with the magical trait for 1 minute; the +4 warp adds a +1 attack bonus.

name: Shape Of The Aberrant
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Base forms replace physical ability scores, Speed and DR wholesale. Temp HP, the Fortitude bonus, the natural attack and the resistance warp are all expressible; the stat-block swap is not. Psychic Lash also uses BSB in place of BAB when higher.

name: Shape Of The Animal
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Temp HP, the +2 Fortitude bonus and the natural attack map cleanly; the Agile/Brawn stat-block replacement does not.

name: Shape Of The Beast
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Same stat-block swap as the other Shape spells. The immunity warp is a defence effect. Source bug: the '+1 PP: gain immunity to either Frightened, Prone or Stunned' warp is listed twice.

name: Shape Of The Elemental
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Per-form immunities are defence effects and the temp HP is a tempHP effect; the Air/Earth/Fire/Water stat blocks and movement modes are not expressible.

name: Shape Of The Eternal
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: The aligned immunity/weakness pair is a defence effect and the innate-spell warps are spell effects; the five base stat blocks and fast healing 1 are not.

name: Shape Of The Fey
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Sleep immunity, mental resistance and cold iron weakness are one defence effect; the three base stat blocks are not expressible. Trickster's teleport-on-miss reaction is its own missing piece, and this Shape grants no Fortitude bonus.

name: Shape Of The Plant
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Immunities and the fire weakness are a defence effect; the Bulwark/Spore Warden/Vine stat blocks are not. Source bug: description says 'While in your fey form'.

name: Shape Of The Wyrm
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Per-form immunity/weakness pairs are defence effects; the six stat blocks are not. The breath weapon is a granted 2 AP basic-reflex attack scaling at 1d8 per PP minus 2.

name: Shape Stone
mechanism: skill check used as a saving throw
note: An Acrobatics check stands in for the save, with degrees deciding prone or falling off. The stone reshaping itself is printed text.

name: Shapechange
mechanism: polymorph form replacing the stat block
note: Harder than the Shape spells: it copies an arbitrary creature stored with Study Target rather than a fixed form list, and allows re-forming for 1 action.

name: Shared Will
note: Up to 6 creatures roll one Will save at the best bonus in the group plus 1 per member, and a failure lands on all of them.

name: Shifting Form
note: Speed is not a bonus slot, and a climb/swim Speed derived from the target's own Speed has no representation. Darkvision, Scent and the claws unarmed attack would be trait and attack effects.

name: Shillelagh
note: Effects target creatures; there is no way to hang a temporary Potency rune on a held weapon, nor to step its potency with the +6 warp.

name: Shroud
mechanism: skill check used as a saving throw
note: An Acrobatics check by an unwilling target sets the duration by degree. Perceiving light two steps lower is also not expressible; the +2 circumstance bonus to saves vs light effects on its own is buildable.

name: Silence
mechanism: prevent actions with a given trait
note: Blocks auditory and sonic actions and spells with verbal components. The +2 warp turns it into a 10-foot emanation imposing the same block on everyone inside.

name: Silent Binding
note: Only mechanical element is the save degree setting the duration.

name: Size Alteration
note: Applies the whole Chapter 12 size modifier table, and the warps step it up or down further.

name: Slay The Soul
mechanism: damage scaled by margin of failure
note: 1 essence damage per point of failure on a partial. The Light Critical, the forced drop to 0 HP with Dying, and death on a fumble are also outside the vocabulary.

name: Sleepwalker
note: Delayed onset (takes effect when the target next falls asleep) has no trigger hook either.

name: Slide
note: Moves a creature to a chosen point, with a d12 scatter roll and 2d6 force damage plus a bounce-back if it lands inside a solid object.

name: Smash
note: Damage is not one of the bonus slots, and the bonus is scoped to objects and constructs. The 0 AP dismissal that doubles the bonus for one roll is a second missing piece.

name: Snagging Pit
note: Needs a pit terrain feature and the falling rules; the spikes warp keys secondary damage off the fall damage. Stunned 1 on a success is a plain condition effect.

name: Solid Fog
note: Concealment both ways plus difficult terrain inside a cloud that may drift 10 feet per round, so the template has to move.

name: Solitude
note: Creatures inside cannot be targeted at all, which is the hardest part. One Will save per creature on first interaction, and the spell ends if the caster leaves.

name: Soul Bind
note: Text is garbled ('a character been dead') and calls the spell 'bind soul' although it is named Soul Bind.

name: Soul Bleed
note: Forces another creature to make an immediate Dying Check, at disadvantage.

name: Spectral Grasp
mechanism: combat manoeuvre using a spell check
note: Runs Disarm, Grapple, Shove or Trip off the Spellcraft check at -4. Warps add a sustained mode repeating the manoeuvre each round, optionally on a new target.

name: Spectral Hand
note: Later touch spells originate from the hand. It also carries the caster's defences and saves and deals 5 damage to the caster if destroyed.

name: Spell Drain
note: Reaction that makes the target's spell fail, and on a failure moves the drained PP into the caster's pool. Nothing edits a PP pool.

name: Spell Immunity
note: A defence effect with field immunity and the named spell as its value, 1 hour, warped to 24. The value is a pick at cast time and enforcement against that specific spell stays with the table.

name: Spell Prime
mechanism: store a spell for later release
note: Binds a second spell now and releases it as a 0 AP action later, excluding spells with the attack or save trait.

name: Spell Storing
mechanism: store a spell for later release
note: Captures the next spell cast into the Mage Staff; warps change the release action cost to a reaction or a free action.

name: Spell Transfer
note: The next spell cast within the duration resolves from a willing creature's position instead of the caster's.

name: Spell Turning
note: Reaction counteract check off Spellcraft, and on success the spell is re-resolved against its own caster, which needs full spell reflection.

name: Spider Climb
note: A climb Speed equal to the target's own Speed. Speed is not a bonus slot and the value is derived from the target.

name: Spike Stones
note: 1d8 piercing per square entered, plus difficult and hazardous terrain, with the spikes hidden behind a Search check opposing the Spell DC.

name: Spirit Mark
note: The target must save each time it tries to turn invisible. Aura concealment additionally needs a counteract check against the spell DC; the direction-and-distance tracking is printed text.

name: Spirit Of The Hunt
mechanism: advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Advantage on Search (Perception), and on Track (Survival) with the +2 warp. A bonus to the perception or survival slot would be a different mechanic, not this one.

name: Spirit Trap
mechanism: recurring save to end an effect
note: A fresh save at the start of each of the target's turns. Also needs a 5-foot movement tether and difficult terrain that applies only to the target.

name: Spiritual Weapon
note: An independent force weapon that copies the wielded weapon's statistics and Strikes with the caster's Spellcraft each time the spell is Sustained, moving to a new target.

name: Spoil The Profane
mechanism: make a weapon Strike as part of the spell
note: Casting immediately triggers a weapon Strike; weakened 1 on a hit is a plain condition effect, and the 1d6 aligned secondary damage is conditional on the target having an opposing aura.

name: Spook
note: The +1 status bonuses to DB and saves apply only while the target keeps away from enemies, and the spell ends if it advances. The -2 circumstance penalty on saves vs fear on its own is a plain bonus effect with a note.

name: Stabilise
note: Suppresses the end-of-turn Dying increase, with a once-per-round-per-creature limit.

name: Startle
note: A forced Step away from the caster on a failure. Frightened 1 on a fumble is a plain condition effect.

name: Stasis
mechanism: remove a creature from play temporarily
note: Untargetable, immune to all damage, immovable, and all ongoing timers paused — no effect kind suspends a target.

name: Stone To Flesh
note: The condition kind applies conditions; clearing petrified is not expressible. The stone-object half is narrative.

name: Stoneskin
note: The resistance itself is BUILDABLE as a qualitative defence effect (field resistance, values adamantine/physical), and the +4 warp just extends values. Only the 1-minute-per-hit duration burn is missing.

name: Stun Relief
note: Also needs to reduce a condition's value at the moment it is applied.

name: Swallow Soul
mechanism: waive the PP cost of a spell
note: The heal is BUILDABLE apart from reading its formula off a corpse's level; the free follow-up cast is the missing clause.

name: Sympathy
note: Only the Sickened 4 on a successful save is buildable; the attraction itself is GM-run.

name: Talon Strike
mechanism: extra damage on a weapon Strike
note: The damage kind is auto-hit spell damage, not a rider attached to Strikes with a specific weapon.

name: Tanglefoot
note: Grapple resolved with Spellcraft at -4, ending at the start of your next turn.

name: Tangling Creepers
note: The -10-foot circumstance penalty to Speeds would be a bonus effect, but it must apply to whoever is inside a lasting template; also a 15-foot-reach Spellcraft grapple launched from any square.

name: Telekinetic Manoeuvre
note: Disarm, Shove or Trip substituting a Spellcraft check for the Combat check.

name: Telepathic Demand
note: A success grants 1 day (1 month on a critical) of immunity to recasting, which nothing tracks.

name: Teleport
note: Mis-teleport consequences are explicitly left to the GM.

name: Teleportation Circle
note: Header labels the 500 gp material cost as a 'Trigger', which looks like a field mix-up.

name: Temporal Stasis
note: Save field says Will but the description never calls for or resolves a saving throw.

name: Thrall
note: Attitude steps (friendly/helpful) are not tracked anywhere in the effects vocabulary.

name: Time Hop
mechanism: remove a creature from play temporarily
note: Caster may return at the start of each turn and is displaced to the nearest free space if occupied.

name: Time Stop
mechanism: grant extra actions outside the turn order
note: 1d6+3 AP rolled secretly by the GM; ends early if the caster affects anyone else or moves 1,000 feet.

name: Tinker
note: 5 HP per caster level would be a plain casterLevelMods heal if object HP were a target the heal kind could address.

name: Touch Of Obedience
note: Penalty durations are keyed to turn boundaries, which the duration field must be able to express.

name: Trace Location
note: Claims to bypass lower-PP insight protections, a layer that does not exist as data.

name: Trade Essence
note: No effect kind reads or writes a creature's PP pool; the amount scales with caster level and clamps at 0 and max.

name: Transmute Rock & Mud
note: Converts existing terrain material between rock and mud and leaves lasting difficult/formidable terrain; also per-degree grabbed/restrained outcomes.

name: Tree Shape
note: DB is overridden to a flat 10 and all bonus types except status/circumstance are suppressed — an override of the modifier stack, not a bonus entry.

name: True Seeing
note: Seeing through darkness, invisibility, illusion and polymorph is a perception mode; the trait kind grants traits, not senses.

name: True Strike
mechanism: grant advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Also ignores circumstance penalties and the concealed/hidden conditions for that one Strike.

name: True Target
mechanism: grant advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Advantage is conditional on which creature is attacked and is consumed once per attacker.

name: Turn Undead
note: Each degree's payload (stunned 1, fleeing, essence critical) is individually BUILDABLE; the branching, undead-only targeting, per-turn re-save in the emanation and level-scaled critical severity are not.

name: Twisted Fate
note: Also disadvantage on checks and 'cannot benefit from chance effects', which is neither a condition nor a bonus.

name: Umbral Veil
note: Reduces illumination by three steps in a moving 20-foot emanation, and can be detached as a decoy that keeps dimming light where it was left.

name: Unity
note: Also lets each ally substitute the caster's saving throw modifier for their own, chosen individually.

name: Unliving Vitality
note: The engine has a fastHealing active-effect flag used by feats, but no spell effect kind authors it.

name: Unseen Servant
note: It has DB 0, 1 HP and Strength -2 and ends when reduced to 0 HP, so it needs a real actor, not a marker.

name: Unshakable
note: defence effect, field immunity, values [stunned], duration 1 minute parsed from the Duration text. Both warps are metadata only — a longer duration and a range change.

name: Untamed Journey
note: Immunity to Speed penalties from environmental sources and free movement through environmental difficult terrain are terrain interactions, not damage-type immunity.

name: Unwelcome Halo
note: Also per-degree branching; the fumble line's +2 circumstance bonus to attacks would be a bonus effect applied to every other creature.

name: Veil Of The Shroud
note: The one mechanical clause is a static DC (Spellcraft DC +4) standing in for a Deception check — a number the GM reads off, not something to compute.

name: Veiled Presence
note: The +2 status bonus to Deception and Stealth is BUILDABLE (bonus effect on the two skill slots) and the +2 PP warp scales it to max +5. Only ignoring crowd difficult terrain is missing.

name: Veiled Secret
note: Two bonus effects (+4 status to skills and to saves); the scope is narrative — the GM decides which checks conceal the secret.

name: Verdant Snare
note: Creates difficult terrain in a radius that persists and can be widened by warps.

name: Vibrant Thorns
note: Text needs an editorial pass: the body escalates after an 'essence spell' while the warp says 'positive spell', and the trigger runs adjacency and 'hits you with an unarmed attack' together.

name: Vigour
note: Heals at the END of the target's turn, where the existing fast-healing sweep fires at the start.

name: Visage Of Horror
mechanism: save triggered by attacking the target
note: The frightened 2 payload is BUILDABLE; the aggressive-move trigger, per-attacker temporary immunity and wasted-action fumble are not. Warp text refers to 'mask of terror', a name used nowhere else.

name: Vital Beacon
mechanism: healing pool that degrades with each use
note: Die type steps down 4d12 to 4d4 across uses, once per round, and the spell ends when the pool is spent.

name: Wake
note: Becomes pure data authoring if a condition effect with value 0 clears the condition rather than applying it — worth confirming in code.

name: Wall Of Dispelling
note: No counteract level or wall statistics are given, so the wall's strength against passing spells is undefined in the text as well as unbuildable.

name: Wall Of Force
mechanism: wall object with HP and hardness
note: Also immunity to counteracting at or below its level and auto-destruction by disintegrate.

name: Wall Of Ice
mechanism: wall object with HP and hardness
note: Sections carry a fire weakness (a defence effect if sections were actors), and a section destroyed by other means leaves difficult terrain dealing 2d6 cold on entry.

name: Wall Of Stone
mechanism: wall object with HP and hardness
note: Per-section DB 0, Hardness 14, 50 HP, immune to critical hits and precision damage; destroyed sections leave difficult terrain.

name: Wall Of Thorns
mechanism: wall object with HP and hardness
note: Entering a wall space costs 2d8 piercing, and both faces grant cover.

name: Wall Of Wind
note: No HP or hardness — it blocks ammunition and gases, applies a -2 circumstance penalty to larger thrown weapons, and runs a per-degree Fortitude save for fliers.

name: War Cry
note: Also adds 1d6 sonic to the ally's weapon and grants that ally a free extra Strike at their current multiple attack penalty.

name: Warped Terrain
note: Radius scales with AP spent at cast time, and each creature disbelieves individually and is thereafter unaffected.

name: Water Breathing
note: Has a range and a 5-foot-radius area but an empty targets field, yet the text says 'the targets' — who is affected is undefined.

name: Waves Of Fatigue
note: Every degree applies fatigued 1 — a BUILDABLE condition effect — and the degrees differ only in duration, so this needs branching plus stacking on repeat casts. Text also lacks a critical line and gives the fumble no duration.

name: Weapon Surge
mechanism: extra damage on a weapon Strike
note: The +1 status bonus to the attack slot is BUILDABLE; adding a die to a weapon Strike and consuming it on that Strike only is not.

name: Web
note: Also a per-degree Athletics/Acrobatics check on entering, and each web space is a destructible object (DB 10, cleared by 5 slashing or 1 fire).

name: Wellspring Of Valour
note: The +1 status bonus to the attack slot with note 'vs creatures of an opposed aura' is BUILDABLE; the 1d6 that fires when an ally first takes damage each round is not. 'Opposed aura' also needs an alignment concept the data does not carry.

name: Wild Morph
mechanism: draw an ability from the Studied Target subsystem
note: The attack kind can grant a natural attack, but the form, movement type or special ability must be copied from a Studied Target, and the duration can retune to Wildshape's.

name: Windy Escape
note: Physical Resistance (non-magic) is complete as written and BUILDABLE as a qualitative defence effect; the reaction trigger and its one-attack scope are the missing part.

name: Wits
mechanism: flat bonus to an ability score
note: The +4 PP warp reads 'increase the bonus by +5 (max +20)' against a +1 base — the step size looks like a typo.

name: Wizard Strike
mechanism: grant advantage or disadvantage on a roll
note: Carries an 'Advantage' trait, which may already be an engine hook worth checking before building anything new.

name: Woeful Dread
note: Introduces a 'Partial' degree used nowhere else, applies mental critical injuries at -20/-10/+10, and chains a second Fortitude save for instant death on a fumble.

name: Word Of Death
note: Instant-death HP thresholds and 'drops to -10 HP' are outcomes a damage effect cannot express; a success is far worse than a critical.

name: Word Of Stunning
note: Each payload is a BUILDABLE condition effect; only the branching and the 10-minute per-target immunity are not. Success (stunned 2) is worse than failure (stunned for 1 round) — confirm that inversion is intended.

name: Zealous Battlecry
note: Both creatures roll d100 and share the higher result for initiative — confirm d100 is the right die for initiative in this system.
